milan-stelvio-and-gavia-serious-pass-day.title: Bormio · Stelvio and Gavia Serious Pass Day
milan-stelvio-and-gavia-serious-pass-day.slogan: Hairpin mythology with no room for fantasy planning.
milan-stelvio-and-gavia-serious-pass-day.story: Hairpin mythology with no room for fantasy planning. 374 km round from Bormio - plan on about 7 h 12 of riding. It goes by way of Santa Maria and Tirano. The climbs: Stelvio Pass and Gavia Pass. It tops out at about 2,750 m. Stelvio Pass and Gavia Pass are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Italy into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.
